ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between low-intensity black/dark grey epidermal background and high-intensity white linear streaks and focal barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark base pigmentation (low intensity) dominant on the left lobe and lower right lobe; right lobe interior displays a high-density field of light-grey/white linear geometric patterns (rake marks); high-intensity white circular blobs (barnacles) distributed along the peripheral margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with high pixel depth relative to the visible lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude peaks coinciding with barnacle attachment points along the trailing margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a linear-to-convex sweep; right lobe exhibits a pronounced convex curve toward the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized along the leading and trailing edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense, multi-directional light-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) covering the majority of the visible ventral surface on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks and significant barnacle colonization on edge margins.
